description: Source code for the LDAP Wizard component in Mattermost's admin console, implementing LDAP configuration UI with various settings and test functionalities.

methods.name: buildTextSetting
methods.description: Creates a LDAPTextSetting component for a given setting.

methods.name: buildBoolSetting
methods.description: Creates a LDAPBooleanSetting component for a given setting.

methods.name: buildDropdownSetting
methods.description: Creates a LDAPDropdownSetting component for a given setting.

methods.name: buildButtonSetting
methods.description: Creates a LDAPButtonSetting component for a given setting, with test result handling.

methods.name: buildJobsTableSetting
methods.description: Creates a LDAPJobsTableSetting component for a given setting.

methods.name: fileUploadSetstate
methods.description: Updates state with filename and error message for file upload settings.

methods.name: buildFileUploadSetting
methods.description: Creates a LDAPFileUploadSetting component for a given setting.

methods.name: buildCustomSetting
methods.description: Creates a LDAPCustomSetting component for a given setting.

methods.name: buildExpandableSetting
methods.description: Creates a LDAPExpandableSetting component for a given setting.

methods.name: nullFunction
methods.description: A placeholder function returning null for unsupported setting types.

methods.name: renderTitle
methods.description: Renders the title/header of the LDAP Wizard.

methods.name: doSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, updating config and managing save actions.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Handles changes to settings, updates state, and optionally triggers submit.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submit event, manages save process and confirmation.

methods.name: unRegisterSaveAction
methods.description: Removes a save action from the list.

methods.name: registerSaveAction
methods.description: Adds a save action to the list.

methods.name: setSaveNeeded
methods.description: Marks that save is needed and blocks navigation.

methods.name: cancelSubmit
methods.description: Cancels the confirmation dialog for submit.

methods.name: canSave
methods.description: Validates whether the form can be saved based on current settings.

methods.name: hybridSchemaAndComponent
methods.description: Renders custom component if schema specifies one.

methods.name: renderSidebar
methods.description: Renders the sidebar navigation for sections.

methods.name: renderSettings
methods.description: Renders the main settings sections and components.
